macros.name: che
macros.doc: The commands “\a”, “\e”, “\i”, “\o”, “\u” and “\E” prints the corresponding letter with a grave accent; the commands “\ee” and “\che” print the letter “e” or the three letters “che” with an acute accent (i.e. “é” and “ché”).
